about: A small help center for an online store: ten passages, the searches its users made, and held-out searches with the passage that answers each. Illustrative text written for these examples.

passages.title: Refund timeline
passages.text: Refunds return to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the return is received.

passages.title: Store credit
passages.text: Store credit is issued immediately when you choose it at return time.

passages.title: Exchanges
passages.text: Exchanges ship once the original item is scanned at the warehouse.

passages.title: Gift cards
passages.text: Gift cards cannot be refunded to a bank account.

passages.title: Two-factor backup codes
passages.text: To sign in without your phone, use one of the backup codes you saved when you turned on two-factor authentication.

passages.title: Two-factor authentication
passages.text: Two-factor authentication adds a code from your phone to every sign-in.

passages.title: Order export
passages.text: Export your orders as a CSV file from Orders > Export, after choosing a date range.

passages.title: Order history
passages.text: Order history shows the last 90 days; older orders are in the yearly archive.

passages.title: Invoice details
passages.text: Add your company name under Settings > Billing; it appears on every invoice issued after the change.

passages.title: Invoices
passages.text: Invoices are available under Billing > Invoices, where you can download each one as a PDF.
